name: Havnai

sources.title: Homepage — 'Havnai - AI Tool Marketplace', React SPA with /submit route
Refund policy — confirms premium paid listings (7-day refund window)

conditions: Free submission requires embedding the 'Featured on Havnai' badge on your website within 24 hours of tool approval, or the listing is deactivated
requirements: AI tools only — site is an AI tool marketplace/directory
Account required: the submit flow checks for a session and redirects to /signin ('Please sign in to submit a tool'); Google sign-in offered
Free-tier submissions are 'pending review' after submit — approval is not instant
Free listing requires the badge embed within 24h; premium ($9 one-time) makes badge optional
preparation: Tool name, URL, description, category, and logo/image
Pricing model for the tool: Free / Paid / Freemium / Free Trial (form has minimum-cost, maximum-cost, and free-trial-detail fields)
Ability to add an embed badge (HTML or React snippet) to your site footer/sidebar if using the free tier
$9 one-time payment if choosing premium (audio description + Instagram reel promotion)
workflow: Create an account / sign in at https://havnai.com/signin (Google OAuth available)
Open https://havnai.com/submit and fill the tool-submission form (name, URL, description, category, pricing details, logo)
Leave the premium toggle off for the free submission, or enable 'Premium Submission ($9)' for the paid tier
After submit, the tool is 'pending review'; copy the badge embed code from Profile → Embed Badge tab (/profile?tab=embed)
Add the badge to your site within 24 hours of approval to keep a free listing active
watchFor: Site is a client-side React SPA — submission pages render empty without JavaScript
Free listing deactivation risk: missing the 24-hour badge window kills the listing
Premium upsell toggle in the form ($9 one-time) — it triggers a payment redirect on submit
Small/new directory (Indian operator, founded 2024); traffic value likely low
countsAsLive: The tool appears on havnai.com tools/category pages after review and the listing is not deactivated for a missing badge
unknowns: Review turnaround time and acceptance criteria
Whether free listings get dofollow links
